instructions: Third and final Visual Director transfer strategy for room_floor_cabinet. Use the still-current approved target at art/room_floor_cabinet/visual_director/round-03/approved-target-r03.png. A compact two-drawer Room B cabinet with an actual shaped lower silhouette: replace the rectangular plinth with four turned bun feet and a shallow scalloped front skirt, retain framed drawer faces, exposed joinery and readable brass cup pulls, and preserve the exact 26 x 21 x 24-inch envelope. Use the alternate Blender construction implemented by generation_variant batch15_room_floor_cabinet_alternate: low-contrast hand-selected oak grain, joined-board topology where specified, and visible fitted construction. Preserve RoomDefinition authority: no changes to room geometry, gameplay, collision, navigation, activity stations, or simulation.
tool: Blender-authored joined-board tops, shaped supports, and fitted cabinetry
post_processing: Import the GLB through the Art Factory and validate it in Godot 4.7.2.
Reject any candidate whose generated visual geometry exceeds its ArtBrief envelope.
Keep all generated furniture meshes out of collision, navigation, selection, and simulation state.
Capture standardized candidate-specific production renders before visual evaluation.
material_method: Low-contrast hand-selected oak/walnut PBR with true plank seams, alternate support profiles, and asset-specific joinery

import_configuration.axis: Blender X width / Y depth / Z height; glTF exporter and Godot importer convert Blender Z-up to Godot Y-up
import_configuration.normalization: Validate visual mesh bounds against the exact ArtBrief envelope; gameplay dimensions and landmarks remain owned by RoomDefinition
